class.name: DSTex
class.brief_description: Reads and writes the DirectStorage compressed texture format.
class.description: [DSTex] creates and inspects [code].dstex[/code] files. The container format supports version 1, version 2, and version 3 textures. Version 2 stores D3D12-aligned mip offsets (512-byte alignment) and 24-byte per-mip footprint metadata ([code]DSTexMipEntryV2[/code] with 256-byte pitch-aligned uncompressed sizes and row pitches), enabling direct GPU GDeflate decompression to VRAM. Version 3 adds a 16-byte header extension recording the authoring (logical) dimensions for sources whose storage was 4-pixel aligned, so the loader can apply a size override. The resource loader can load [code].dstex[/code] files as [Texture2D] or [Texture2DRD] resources automatically.

method.name: get_file_info
method.description: Returns the same header and mip metadata dictionary as [method read_header].

method.name: get_srgb_rd_format
method.description: Returns the corresponding sRGB [RenderingDevice] data format for the given format, or returns the original format if no sRGB variant exists.

method.name: godot_format_to_rd_format
method.description: Converts an [Image] format value to the corresponding [RenderingDevice] data format value. If [param is_srgb] is [code]true[/code], returns the corresponding sRGB format variant when supported.

method.name: is_format_supported
method.description: Returns whether the specified [Image] format is supported for [DSTex] storage and DirectStorage decompression.

method.name: is_rd_format_srgb
method.description: Returns whether the given [RenderingDevice] data format represents an sRGB color space format.

method.name: read_from_file
method.description: Reads a complete [code].dstex[/code] file with defensive bounds checking (supporting up to 16 mipmaps). The result contains [code]header[/code] ([Dictionary]), [code]compressed_data[/code] ([PackedByteArray]), [code]mip_offsets[/code] ([PackedInt64Array]), [code]mip_sizes[/code] ([PackedInt32Array]), [code]mip_uncompressed_sizes[/code] ([PackedInt32Array]), and [code]mip_row_pitches[/code] ([PackedInt32Array]). For version 2 files, it also includes [code]mip_data[/code] ([Array] of [PackedByteArray] containing per-mip payloads). Returns an empty dictionary when the file is invalid, corrupted, or cannot be opened.

method.name: read_header
method.description: Reads and validates the [code].dstex[/code] header and mip table (validating mip table bounds and enforcing a maximum of 16 mip levels before allocating memory). The result contains [code]magic[/code] ([int]), [code]version[/code] ([int]), [code]flags[/code] ([int]), [code]width[/code] ([int]), [code]height[/code] ([int]), [code]pixel_format[/code] ([int]), [code]mip_count[/code] ([int]), [code]original_size[/code] ([int]), [code]compressed_size[/code] ([int]), [code]reserved[/code] ([int]), [code]logical_width[/code] ([int]), [code]logical_height[/code] ([int]), [code]depth_or_layers[/code] ([int]), [code]mip_offsets[/code] ([PackedInt64Array]), [code]mip_sizes[/code] ([PackedInt32Array]), [code]mip_uncompressed_sizes[/code] ([PackedInt32Array]), and [code]mip_row_pitches[/code] ([PackedInt32Array]). For version 3 files, [code]logical_width[/code]/[code]logical_height[/code] are the authoring dimensions (falling back to the storage dimensions when the file records none); for older versions they equal [code]width[/code]/[code]height[/code]. Returns an empty dictionary on validation failure.

method.name: normalize_image
method.description: Normalizes the RGB of every base-level pixel in [param image] as a tangent-space normal (the (R*2-1, G*2-1, B*2-1) vector is scaled to unit length and encoded back). Alpha is preserved. This mirrors [method Image.normalize] (which is not exposed to scripting) and operates on the base level only; generate mipmaps afterwards if the texture needs a chain.

method.name: remap_channels
method.description: Remaps the channels of every base-level pixel in [param image], mirroring [ResourceImporterTexture]'s channel remap (which is not exposed to scripting). Each channel argument is 0-10: Red, Green, Blue, Alpha, Inverted Red/Green/Blue/Alpha, Unused, Zero, One. The identity mapping (0, 1, 2, 3) on a full-channel image is a no-op. Operates on the base level only; call before mip generation.

method.name: rd_format_to_godot_format
method.description: Converts a [RenderingDevice] data format value to the corresponding [Image] format value.

method.name: write_to_file
method.description: Compresses [param raw_data] with GDeflate and writes a [code].dstex[/code] file. Calculates D3D12 footprint metadata (256-byte aligned row pitch and 512-byte aligned mip data placements) for hardware GPU decompression. [param format] is an [Image] format value. If [param is_srgb] is [code]true[/code], sets the sRGB format flag in the header and encodes the format as sRGB. If [param as_image_texture] is [code]true[/code], flags the texture for ImageTexture CPU compatibility. When [param logical_width]/[param logical_height] differ from [param width]/[param height] (a non-multiple-of-4 source whose storage was 4-pixel aligned), writes a version 3 file recording the authoring size so the loader can apply a size override; otherwise writes version 2. [param depth_or_layers] is reserved for 3D/array textures and must be 0 or 1. Rejects dimensions above 16384 pixels, and a mip footprint or compressed payload above 512 MiB, with [constant ERR_INVALID_DATA]. Returns [constant OK] on success, [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] on invalid parameters, [constant ERR_INVALID_DATA] on a layout mismatch, oversized texture, or compression failure, or [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] if the format is unsupported; or the error reported by [method FileAccess.get_open_error] (for example [constant ERR_CANT_OPEN], [constant ERR_FILE_NO_PERMISSION], or [constant ERR_FILE_CANT_WRITE]) if the output file cannot be opened for writing.
